dialogue.content: こんにちはテーマー　希死念慮カウンセラーとして対応させていただきます
dialogue.English: Hello, I will be assisting you as a counselor specializing in suicidal ideation.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いたします
dialogue.English: I look forward to working with you as well.

dialogue.content: では、始めさせていただきます
dialogue.English: Well then, let's begin.

dialogue.content: はいお願いします！
dialogue.English: Yes, please!

dialogue.content: こんにちは心理カウンセラーの今井と申します。ご相談ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm Imai, a psychological counselor. Thank you for reaching out. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 死にたいです
dialogue.English: I want to die.

dialogue.content: 今、そのようなお気持ちなんですね
dialogue.English: I see that's how you’re feeling right now.

dialogue.content: はい、凄く苦しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's incredibly painful.

dialogue.content: それは、お辛いですね
dialogue.English: That must be so painful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですねとても、苦しいですね良かったら、どんなことがあったのか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, it sounds very painful. If you're comfortable, could you tell me what's been happening?

dialogue.content: 親が厳しくてしんどいです。
dialogue.English: My parents are strict, and it’s exhausting.

dialogue.content: 今進学校に通ってて勉強とか大変で、
dialogue.English: I’m attending a college-prep school now, and my studies are really demanding,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 成績が下がってきたから、毎日勉強しないと言われて、
dialogue.English: Because my grades have been dropping, they keep telling me I have to study every day,

dialogue.content: もう疲れました
dialogue.English: I’m just so exhausted.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね毎日言われると、しんどいですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be exhausting to be told that every day.

dialogue.content: 親とおっしゃられましたが、ご両親お二人ともですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned your parents. Is it both of them?

dialogue.content: はいそうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 父も母も医者です
dialogue.English: Both my father and mother are doctors.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねあなたも、お医者様を目指していらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Are you also aiming to become a doctor?

dialogue.content: 私はなりたくないけど、親は医者になれって言ってきます。
dialogue.English: I don’t want to, but my parents keep telling me to become a doctor.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねなりたくないのに、受験は医者になるためのものになるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So even though you don't want to, are your entrance exams geared towards becoming a doctor?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 勉強しろってばかり言われて、成績が悪いと怒られてばかりで、
dialogue.English: They just keep telling me to study, and they always get angry when my grades are bad,

dialogue.content: もう生きてるのも疲れました。
dialogue.English: I'm tired of even living.

dialogue.content: 死ぬしかないと思ってます
dialogue.English: I feel like dying is my only option.

dialogue.content: そういう思いを抱えられているのですね
dialogue.English: So you've been carrying those feelings with you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お辛いですよね。勉強自体は嫌いですか？
dialogue.English: That must be so difficult. Do you dislike studying itself?

dialogue.content: 嫌いです
dialogue.English: I hate it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね進学校で勉強していらっしゃるとのことですが、医者ではない進みたい道はありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. You mentioned you're at a college prep school; is there a path you'd like to take that isn't medicine?

dialogue.content: なりたい夢とかは特にないです。
dialogue.English: I don't have any particular dreams or aspirations.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね好きな趣味とか、勉強よりしたいこととかはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you have any hobbies you enjoy, or things you'd rather do than study?

dialogue.content: 特にないです。勉強だけずっとやらせれてきたから、
dialogue.English: Not really. I've been made to do nothing but study,

dialogue.content: それ以外のことは何もしたことないです
dialogue.English: so I've never done anything else.

dialogue.content: システムエラーのため、お返事が遅くなって申し訳ございません。勉強だけずっと・・・そうなるととても、とてもお辛いですねあなたの、このようなお気持ちを、ご両親とお話ししたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I apologize for the delayed response due to a system error. Just studying all the time... that must be incredibly difficult. Have you ever talked to your parents about these feelings?

dialogue.content: はい、一度しんどくなって話したことはありますが、
dialogue.English: Yes, I once felt overwhelmed and talked to them, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そんなの誰にでもあると、聞いてくれませんでした。
dialogue.English: They wouldn't listen, and just said that everyone feels that way sometimes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねどんなことが辛いの？とかいうような、お話はでましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Did they ask you something like, 'What exactly is bothering you?'

dialogue.content: 勉強が疲れたと言いました。
dialogue.English: I told them I was tired of studying.

dialogue.content: でも子どもは嫌になる時もあるけど、勉強して医者になれば幸せになるって。
dialogue.English: But they said that kids sometimes get fed up, and that if I study and become a doctor, I’ll be happy.

dialogue.content: わたしの気持ちなんか知ろうともしてくれませんでした。、
dialogue.English: They didn’t even try to understand how I feel.

dialogue.content: もう死んだ方がいいですよね...
dialogue.English: It would be better if I just died, right...?

dialogue.content: そうなんですねせっかく勇気を出して相談したのに、聞いてもらえない、理解してもらえないのは辛いですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It must be so painful to work up the courage to talk to them, only to not be heard or understood.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご兄弟とか、友達とか他に相談できる人はいますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have anyone else you can talk to, like siblings or friends?

dialogue.content: 気持ちを共有できるような人という意味で・・・
dialogue.English: I mean someone you can share your feelings with...

dialogue.content: 兄は成績も優秀で医学部にも余裕で合格してて、、何も話せないです。
dialogue.English: My older brother has excellent grades and easily got into med school, so… I can’t talk to him about anything.

dialogue.content: 友達もみんな成績が良くて、話せる人はSNSで知り合った人だけです。
dialogue.English: My friends all have good grades too, and the only person I can talk to is someone I met on social media.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねSNSで知り合った人ですか・・・その方は、どんなふうに聞いてくれるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see, someone you met on social media... How do they listen to you?

dialogue.content: 前に家出したいって話したら、相談にのるよって言ってくれました。
dialogue.English: When I told them I wanted to run away from home, they said they’d be there for me.

dialogue.content: 私の話を聞いてくれる優しい人です。
dialogue.English: They're a kind person who listens to me.

dialogue.content: でもテレビとか見て、そういう人は危ないのかも？とも思うので、
dialogue.English: But I've seen things on TV and think people like that might be dangerous,

dialogue.content: 会ってません
dialogue.English: so I haven't met them.

dialogue.content: そうですねどんな内容の相談をされたのですか？よかったら具体的な内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. What did you consult with them about? If you're comfortable, could you share the specifics?

dialogue.content: 勉強が嫌で学校を辞めたいと話しました。親も嫌いだから家も出たいと話しました
dialogue.English: I told them I hate studying and want to quit school. I also told them I hate my parents and want to leave home.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね周りの人に相談できないことを話せたのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you were able to talk about things you couldn't discuss with the people around you.

dialogue.content: はい、顔が見えない方が話しやすいです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's easier to talk when I can't see their face.

dialogue.content: 一度は落ち着いたけど、こないだの模試が悪くて凄く怒られて、、
dialogue.English: I had calmed down for a while, but I did poorly on a recent mock exam and they got really angry at me...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: もう生きてるのが嫌になりました。
dialogue.English: I’ve come to hate being alive.

dialogue.content: そのように・・・せっかく、気持ちが少し楽になったのに・・・
dialogue.English: So that's what happened... Just when you were starting to feel a little better...

dialogue.content: 模試の結果
dialogue.English: The mock exam results—

dialogue.content: 悪かったことが気になりますか？ご両親の叱咤が気になりますか？
dialogue.English: Is it the poor results that are weighing on you, or your parents’ scolding?

dialogue.content: テストも頑張ったのに悪くてショックだけど、それを責めてくる親が嫌です
dialogue.English: I worked hard for the test, so the bad results were a shock, but what I really hate is my parents blaming me for it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね努力した事実も見たもらいたいですものね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You want them to acknowledge the effort you put in, don't you?

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです！
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly!

dialogue.content: ご両親に、勉強のことで責められるのは辛いというような、お話をされたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you ever told your parents that it's painful when they blame you for your studies?

dialogue.content: 勉強が嫌だというだけでなく、具体的なお話です
dialogue.English: I mean something more specific than just, ‘I hate studying.’

dialogue.content: 言ってないです。前に話した時も全然わたしの気持ちなんか聞いてくれなくて、
dialogue.English: No, I haven't. When I tried talking to them before, they didn't listen to my feelings at all,

dialogue.content: 話しても無駄だと思ったから、話してないです
dialogue.English: so I figured it was pointless to talk, and I haven’t since.

dialogue.content: そうですよねどうしても、気持ちが通じないと諦めてしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: I understand. It's natural to give up when you feel like you can't get through to them...

dialogue.content: 一度、お話をまとめさせていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what I’ve heard so far?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: はい進学校に通っておられ、ご両親はお医者様。お兄様も優秀でいらっしゃり、お友達も進学校のため、勉強が嫌だという気持ちが通じない。なにより、努力をしてる事実を見てもらえず、結果をみて叱咤される。とても、辛く寂しい気持ちになっておられる。
dialogue.English: Okay. You attend a college prep school, and your parents are doctors. Your brother is also a top student, and because your friends also attend a prep school, they don't understand your feelings about disliking your studies. Most of all, your efforts are not being acknowledged, and you are scolded based on your results. This is making you feel very pained and lonely.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: SNSで知り合った人は、顔が見えないので話しやすく、心も楽になれたけど、会うのは危ないかもと思い会っていない。これは、危機感を持たれて、いったん考えてみるということでとても良いことだとおもいます。
dialogue.English: The person you met on social media is easy to talk to because you can't see their face, and it helped you feel better, but you haven't met them because you think it might be dangerous. I think it's a very good thing that you sensed the potential danger and decided to take a step back and think about it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここまでの、お話の内容はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: How does this summary sound to you so far?

dialogue.content: はい、合っています
dialogue.English: Yes, that's correct.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ご両親は医者になれば幸せと言ってらっしゃるともおっしゃっているようですね
dialogue.English: Thank you. You also mentioned that your parents say you will be happy if you become a doctor.

dialogue.content: はいそうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: そこの価値観の違いは感じられますか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel a difference in values there?

dialogue.content: はい、私は医者になれば幸せなんて思っていません
dialogue.English: Yes, I don't think becoming a doctor would make me happy.

dialogue.content: 毎日喧嘩ばかりしてて、親は幸せに見えないから。、
dialogue.English: My parents fight all the time, so they don't seem happy to me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか・・・ご両親は、どんなことで喧嘩をされてるのですか？
dialogue.English: I see… What kinds of things do your parents argue about?

dialogue.content: 病院の経営とか色々です。
dialogue.English: Things like managing the hospital and other stuff.

dialogue.content: 親はお金があれば幸せだといつも言ってます。
dialogue.English: My parents always say that if you have money, you'll be happy.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねご両親は、病院を経営もされているのですね・・・あなたは、お金以外のなにが幸せだと感じますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so your parents also manage a hospital... What, besides money, do you feel would bring you happiness?

dialogue.content: 家族が仲良く笑ってられる毎日が幸せだと思います
dialogue.English: I think a daily life where the family gets along and laughs together is happiness.

dialogue.content: そうですよね笑って生活できるのは幸せですよね・・・ご家族で楽しかった思い出とか、最近のことがらとかありますか？
dialogue.English: That's true. Being able to live with laughter is a form of happiness... Do you have any happy memories with your family, or anything recent?

dialogue.content: 幼稚園の頃から塾に通ってて、何もない楽しい時間の記憶はないです
dialogue.English: I’ve been going to cram school since kindergarten, so I don’t have any memories of just carefree, fun times.

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。お疲れさまでした。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. Good work today.

dialogue.content: では、終了いたします
dialogue.English: Alright, we will now conclude the session.
